snippet.title: Directive 8020 | Pre-Order Trailer
snippet.description:
Directive 8020 releases 12th May 2026. PRE-ORDER NOW on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S: https://www.thedarkpictures.com/games/directive-8020

For a limited time only, receive with every purchase: The Dark Pictures Outfit Pack, Additional Dark Pictures Collectibles, Cinematic Filter Packs, Digital Artbook and exclusive soundtrack

From the creators of UNTIL DAWN and THE QUARRY - an all-new cinematic sci-fi horror adventure that blends intense survival gameplay with meaningful choices and a branching storyline.

Song: Comply by Blood Red Shoes

Come and join the Official Supermassive Games Discord to chat all things Supermassive Games and Directive 8020: discord.gg/supermassivegames
